plugin.name: Ultimate Spider-Man Fusion Fix
MAIN_SkipIntro.description: Skip startup logos and the copyright screen. Restart after changing this value.
MAIN_HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Use Auto for full-screen HUD width, or 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 or a custom ratio up to 32:9. Changes apply at the next game frame.
MAIN_FPSLimit.description: Target frame rate: 0 unlimited, -1 current monitor refresh rate, or 30–1000 FPS. Default 60. Changes apply while the game runs. Higher rates may affect game behavior.
MAIN_FOVFactor.description: Gameplay field-of-view multiplier, from 0.5 to 2.0. 1.0 preserves the corrected original view. Comic panels, scripted cameras and native zoom views keep their own framing. Applies at the next game frame. Widening stops at 150 degrees horizontally, preserving a neutral view that is already wider.
MAIN_DrawDistanceScale.description: Scale world draw and streaming distance. Values above 2 expand allocations experimentally and may cause crashes. Restart after changing this value.
GRAPHICS_SMAA.description: Apply SMAA before the UI. Incompatible with native MSAA. Changes apply while the game is running.
GRAPHICS_ConsoleGamma.description: Apply the console-style gamma curve for deeper contrast. Changes apply while the game is running.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window at the selected resolution, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Changes apply at the next game frame. Alt+Enter returns to the last window mode.
MAIN_PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game while another window is active. Turn off to keep the game running in the background. Changes apply immediately.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Resets this page to its defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.FOVFactor.help: Changes the camera width. 1.0 keeps the original framing.
menu.FixHUD.help: Corrects HUD proportions and placement. Restart the game to apply.
menu.SkipIntro.help: Skips startup logos. Story movies still play. Restart the game to apply.
MAIN_TextLanguage.description: Choose the language used by the fix settings. Auto follows the game language.
MAIN_FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
menu.pluginshelp: Choose a plugin to change its settings. Left and Right change a value; Enter or A confirms. F1 or X shows full help; Up and Down scroll it. Escape or B returns. Press P or Y in Options to open Plugins.
MAIN_CameraAutoCenter.description: Original restores the game's immediate camera following. Delayed keeps your mouse or stick view until you stop looking, then smoothly returns behind Spider-Man. It returns sooner while moving fast. Off keeps your chosen view. Changes apply immediately.
MAIN_CameraRecenterDelay.description: Seconds to wait after mouse or stick camera input stops. Fast movement shortens this delay. Changes apply immediately.
MAIN_Language.description: Override the game's language without changing the registry. Only installed language files are available. Auto keeps the game's own setting. Restart to apply.
language.unavailable: Language overrides require a supported executable and the corresponding installed language files.
MAIN_MouseSensitivity.description: Multiplies mouse camera movement. 1.0 keeps the existing speed; changes apply immediately.
MAIN_InvertMouseY.description: Reverse vertical mouse camera movement. Changes apply immediately and do not affect the controller.
MAIN_GamepadCameraSpeed.description: Multiplies right-stick camera speed after the native response curve. Mouse look, inversion, movement and recenter timing keep their own settings. 1.0 keeps the original speed.
MAIN_CheckForUpdates.description: Checks for a newer fix once when enabled. A notice appears in Options; FusionFixHub handles updates after the game exits. Off makes no network requests.
update.availablehub: A newer Fusion Fix is available. Open FusionFixHub after leaving the game.
update.availablesite: A newer Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
